releases.name: IFCCAD 2026.48.0 alpha
changes: Drawing-owned DWG/DXF/IFCCAD source descriptors with independent stable local source IDs and allocation history. Multiple placements and unused definitions are supported. Equal paths, names or fingerprints do not merge identities.
URI-reference and search-filename locations retain their authored spelling. Core validation performs no filesystem/network IO. Missing sources are valid.

Model XREF placements use O/X/Y, source base point and one positive uniform effective scale. Native Attach/Overlay is a per-relationship property; Attach is the omitted default. Source geometry stays external.

Official Document #32 and Studio #3651 provide typed exchange, finite nested loading, overlay propagation, cycle diagnostics and source-save refresh. Cycle cuts and loaded graphics are session-only, preserving authored references through editing, undo/redo, native offline save and physical CAD readback.
Explorer integration adopts the official merges and the grouped three-format example, owner-scoped source choice/reuse and current source diagnostics.

releases.name: IFCCAD 2026.47.0 alpha
changes: Stores CTB and STB references as external plot-style sources. A layout can retain its table reference and an optional SHA-256 fingerprint, including when plot styles are disabled. The drawing stores its color-dependent or named mode.

Stores named STB assignments on layers and entities and retains the explicit ByBlock and Normal choices. CTB output uses the original ACI when an IFCCAD RGB fallback changes, with a conversion diagnostic.

The shared Document route retains table names when writing DXF and DWG. It reports the loss of a known fingerprint and rejects export when two different table fingerprints share one filename. Keep the external CTB or STB files with the drawings for plotting.

Explorer uses the merged Document and Studio revisions. The CTB and STB round trips through Explorer retained the tested plot assignments, and Studio reproduced the expected PDF colors and lineweights from the exported files.
[IFCCAD plot styles issue](https://github.com/OpenAEC-Foundation/ifccad/issues/16)
[Codec changes](https://github.com/hakanaktt/acadrust/pull/474)
[Document mapping](https://github.com/HakanSeven12/opencaddocument/pull/28)
[Studio plot output](https://github.com/HakanSeven12/OpenCADStudio/pull/3177)

releases.name: IFCCAD 2026.46.1 alpha
changes: Adds native CAD tables with typed cells, merged ranges, styles and overrides. Cells can reference blocks and fields. The model stores formulas, data links, saved cell values and optional table graphics. Studio handles recalculation and refresh.
Adds shared preservation for selected ModelSpace MLINE content. Several preserved roots can refer to one stored Document selection package. Studio retains blocked roots when editing and saving IFCX.
Explorer uses the official Document and Studio integrations. It shows the backing package in the inspection graph and adds one parts-list table to the existing entity catalogue.
[Document table mapping](https://github.com/HakanSeven12/opencaddocument/pull/18)
[Document shared preservation](https://github.com/HakanSeven12/opencaddocument/pull/19)
[Studio table commands](https://github.com/HakanSeven12/OpenCADStudio/pull/2914)
[Studio shared preservation](https://github.com/HakanSeven12/OpenCADStudio/pull/2957)

releases.name: IFCCAD 2026.46.0 alpha
changes: Adds classic Leader, MultiLeader and Tolerance, with typed owned parts, annotation references and supplied graphics.

Adds standalone splines, Hatch spline edges and Paper viewport spline clips. The Document route keeps control and fit data where the target can carry them. DWG output diagnoses omitted fit data in mixed definitions. Strict spline export refuses a target that would lose that data.

Adds compact Leader, MultiLeader and open cubic spline samples to the Explorer entity catalogue. The Leader sample includes a Tolerance annotation. Explorer includes the merged Studio correction for drawing compact periodic splines. The build pins Document `b7f02ad6`, acadrust `acad0df2` and Studio `668ae67b`. The codec pin includes the rational-weight DXF correction.
